_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Wëër ë ŋɛn ku jɔl yɛn ë thɛɛr {width}×{height}.
Yin aya wëër ë ŋɛn {player_id}. Cɛŋ cɛ̈ wëër: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kɛn a w/s/a/d).
Tiɛm ë yin: wɛ̈t lɔ ku jɔl yɛn ku bɛn ë lɔ̈k, kɛn a wëër ë lɔ̈k ku wɛ̈t tiŋ ë riɛl ku ɣɔ̈ɔ̈k (pɛ̈i ë tiŋ {max_turns} tiŋ).

board.after_moves: Akutë akutnhom de kɔc tɔ̈ thïn: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} acï thou në kë cenë yen lɔ̈ɔ̈m.

outcome.survived_win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï pïïr; kɔc kɔ̈k ëbën aacï thou.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Käpiɛny ëbën aacï thou në kaam töŋ yic.
outcome.outlived: Raan ye kek gam acï bɛ̈n pïïr apɛi.
outcome.turn_limit: Thëm cï bɛ̈n nhial acï thök - raan cë käŋ yök apɛi ee yen bï tiam.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Kɛmken ë riɛl kuɛr (kɛm ë ɣɔ̈ɔ̈k → kɛm ë lɔ̈k): {groups}
